title: Ritos y tradiciones de Huarochirí (Taylor 1987) — Biblioteca Digital Curt Nimuendajú
notes: The collection is the single-text digitisation of Gerald Taylor's 1987 IEP/IFEA edition of the Huarochiri manuscript (Quechua, ca. 1608), held on the Biblioteca Digital Curt Nimuendaju at etnolinguistica.org (PDF verified live: https://etnolinguistica.wdfiles.com/local--files/biblio%3Ataylor-1987-ritos/TaylorG_1987_RitosYTradicionesDeHuarochiri.pdf). The Renascor Corpus has only the reconstituted quechua text as plain text-derived 'keyed' material. Publicly downloadable; not a TEI project. Origin verbatim: Taylor (ed.) 1987 via Biblioteca Digital Curt Nimuendaju / etnolinguistica.org. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: The site footer says 'Except where otherwise noted, content on this site is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 License'; the file is a PDF of Taylor's 1987 print edition (IEP / IFEA) and the page notes no separate licence for it, so the site-wide statement may not reflect the rights holders' position.
